hpi_master.description: Every FHFA House Price Index series in one file (17 MB, about 186,000 rows): purchase-only monthly U.S. and census divisions (NSA and SA), quarterly purchase-only, all-transactions and expanded-data indexes for the U.S., divisions, states and metro areas, plus distress-free, non-metro, manufactured-home and Puerto Rico indexes. The pack reads the whole file and keeps the rows that match the filters.

hpi_type.desc: index family (traditional = the standard FHFA HPI)

hpi_flavor.desc: purchase-only (flagship; sales only), all-transactions (adds refinance appraisals), expanded-data (purchase-only plus county recorder and FHA data)

frequency.desc: monthly exists only for purchase-only U.S. and census divisions

place_id.desc: USA, a division code (DV_ENC, DV_PAC, ...), a state abbreviation, or a CBSA code; a list matches any

place_name.desc: exact place name (United States, Vermont, ...); a list matches any

where.desc: more equality filters {column: value or list}; matching ignores case and surrounding spaces

hpi_state.description: Quarterly all-transactions HPI for the 50 states and DC, 1975Q1 on, NSA, 1980Q1 = 100 (188 KB; the same numbers as hpi_master all-transactions State rows). The file has no header row: the pack names the columns state, yr, qtr, index_nsa.

where.desc: more equality filters {column: value or list}

hpi_annual.description: Annual all-transactions HPI (developmental) for the nation, states, CBSAs, counties or three-digit ZIP codes: annual change (%) and the index on three bases (first year = 100, 1990 = 100, 2000 = 100), NSA, through the last full year. County 5.3 MB, CBSA 2.1 MB, ZIP3 1.9 MB.

geography.desc: national, state, cbsa, county or zip3 (ZIP5 and tract files are too large: see source.md)

where.desc: equality filters on the file's columns {column: value or list}: State / Abbreviation / FIPS (state), State / County / FIPS code (county), CBSA / Name (cbsa), Three-Digit ZIP Code (zip3)

loan_limits.description: Conforming loan limits by county for one calendar year (Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac; HERA-based), for one- to four-unit properties: about 3,235 counties. CSV files exist for 2024 on; next year's file appears when FHFA announces the limits in late November. Columns are renamed to snake_case and dollar amounts made plain numbers.

year.desc: calendar year of the limits, 2024 or later (2022-2023 are .xlsx only: manual)

where.desc: more equality filters {column: value or list}, snake_case names (county_name, cbsa_number, fips_state_code)

fhlb_pudb.description: Federal Home Loan Bank System Public Use Database: one row per single-family mortgage acquired by an FHLBank in the year (loan amount, LTV, note rate, borrower income, census tract, race, sex, age, credit score bucket). 12 MB for 2025. Enterprise (Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac) loan-level files are large zips: manual.

where.desc: equality filters {column: value or list} on the file's columns (Bank, FIPSStateNumericCode, FIPSCountyCode, CoreBasedStatisticalAreaCode, LoanPurposeType, BorrowerFirstTimeHomebuyer, PropertyUnitCount)

hpi_us_po_monthly.name: Purchase-only HPI, U.S. and census divisions, monthly (NSA and SA)
hpi_us_po_monthly.description: Flagship monthly FHFA HPI: hpi_master with hpi_flavor purchase-only, frequency monthly, place_id USA (or a division)

hpi_state_po_quarterly.name: Purchase-only HPI by state, quarterly (NSA and SA)
hpi_state_po_quarterly.description: hpi_master with hpi_flavor purchase-only, frequency quarterly, level State

hpi_metro.name: HPI by metro area (CBSA), quarterly
hpi_metro.description: hpi_master with level MSA: all-transactions and expanded-data for 410 metros and metro divisions, purchase-only for the 100 largest

hpi_state_at.name: All-transactions HPI by state, quarterly, since 1975

hpi_zip3_annual.name: Annual HPI by three-digit ZIP code (developmental)

conforming_loan_limits.name: Conforming loan limits by county
conforming_loan_limits.description: loan_limits with a year; baseline and high-cost (HERA) limits for one to four units
